# BigOSheet

> A free, static Big O cheat sheet for time and space complexity in data structures, algorithms, and coding interview patterns.

The site publishes its reference content as server-rendered, crawlable HTML and is available at https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/.

## Main reference pages

- [Big O basics](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/basics/): notation, growth rates, and complexity cases.
- [Data structure complexity](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/data-structures/): operation costs for common structures and graph representations.
- [Sorting algorithm complexity](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/sorting/): best, average, and worst-case time and auxiliary space.
- [Search and graph algorithms](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/algorithms/): search, traversal, shortest paths, and spanning trees.
- [All topics](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/topics/): explanations, code, caveats, and references.
- [Complexity lookup](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/lookup/): operation-level best, average, and worst cases.

## Additional resources

- [Printable revision sheet](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/revision/)
- [PDF cheat sheet](https://bigosheet.aryankr.in/Big-O-Sheet.pdf)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/aryanjsx/BigOSheet)

Complexity bounds include their stated assumptions. They are asymptotic references, not benchmark results.
